---
title: "Safety Information"
---


## Warnings and precautions

Users are provided with these general warnings and precautions.

::: {.callout-important}
## For professional use only
This device is to be operated only by trained clinicians.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Patient safety
Use appropriate infection control measures. The device should be sanitized between documentation sessions.
:::

::: {.callout-danger}
## Avoid direct eye exposure.
The device uses a Class 1 low-power aiming laser diode (520 nm). Do not aim the laser beam at the eyes of patients or clinicians. Do not stare directly into the laser beam or point it at anyone’s eyes.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Goggles
The OralEye™ Imaging System complies with international safety standards for light emission. However, users should avoid looking directly into the blue light while it is operating. To reduce discomfort and the risk of eye injury, patients are provided with protective goggles similar to those used with composite curing lights, and these should be worn by the patient during use**.**
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Battery
Only charge the device with the supplied power adapter. Do not attempt to service the battery.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Environment
Use the device in a controlled environment. Avoid exposure to excessive moisture, heat, or dust.
:::
